    19	def test_build_feature_matrix_dummy():
    20	    raw = pd.DataFrame({
    21	        "formula_pretty": ["BN", "SiC", "AlN"],
    22	        "bulk_modulus_vrh": [200.0, 230.0, 210.0],
    23	        "band_gap_ev": [4.5, 2.3, 3.2],
    24	    })
    25	    result = build_feature_matrix(raw, formula_col="formula_pretty")
    26	    assert isinstance(result, pd.DataFrame)
    27	    assert result.shape[0] == 3
    28	    # Should have original cols + element fraction features (118 for full periodic table)
    29	    feature_cols = [c for c in result.columns if c not in ["formula_pretty", "bulk_modulus_vrh", "band_gap_ev"]]
    30	    assert len(feature_cols) >= 100  # rich feature set

    33	def test_split_features_targets():
    34	    raw = pd.DataFrame({
    35	        "formula_pretty": ["BN", "SiC"],
    36	        "material_id": ["mp-1", "mp-2"],
    37	        "bulk_modulus_vrh": [200, 230],
    38	        "band_gap_ev": [4.5, 2.3],
    39	    })
    40	    df = build_feature_matrix(raw, formula_col="formula_pretty")
    41	    df["bulk_modulus_vrh"] = raw["bulk_modulus_vrh"].values
    42	    df["band_gap_ev"] = raw["band_gap_ev"].values
    43	    X, y = split_features_targets(df)
    44	    assert list(y.columns) == ["bulk_modulus_vrh", "band_gap_ev"]
    45	    assert "bulk_modulus_vrh" not in X.columns
    46	    assert "band_gap_ev" not in X.columns
    47	    assert X.shape[0] == 2
    48	    assert y.shape[0] == 2

    67	def test_full_pipeline_smoke():

    72	        "bulk_modulus_vrh": [200.0, 230.0, 210.0],
    73	        "band_gap_ev": [4.5, 2.3, 3.2],
    74	    })
    75	    # Direct feature + split + save test (not full MPRester call)
    76	    full_df = build_feature_matrix(raw, formula_col="formula_pretty")
